resources.title: Regional Counsellors Guide
resources.description: Appointed by each Classis to provide confidential mentoring, pastoral consultation, conflict resolution assistance, and support for pastors, spouses, and Sessions.
keyDuties: Build supportive mentoring relationships with ministers and pastoral couples within the Classis.
Offer confidential consultation to pastors navigating ministry pressures, transition, or family demands.
Advise Sessions and church councils on pastoral care, vacancy processes, and healthy leadership rhythms.
Assist early and constructively when interpersonal or congregational conflict emerges.
Direct churches to specialist denomination resources (Shift Coaching, Safe Church Unit, NCD Health Checks).
Support interim care and preaching coordination when congregations experience a pastoral vacancy.
Encourage continuing theological study and ministry development pathways.
Report general care observations (without breaking pastoral confidence) to Classis as required.
